name: weeek
description: Weeek task tracker: read and change tasks, comments and attachments

interface.shortDescription: Work with your Weeek tasks in plain language
interface.longDescription: Ask about your Weeek workspace the way you would ask a colleague: what is on the board, who is on a task, what was said in its discussion. Then act on it — create and update tasks, move them between columns, complete them, assign people, post comments in markdown, and pull an attachment down to read it. Answers come back written for a conversation rather than as raw API JSON: names instead of ids, markdown instead of HTML, and a sentence telling you how to reach the next page. Your API token is stored in this machine's keychain by a one-line setup command, so it never sits in a configuration file.
defaultPrompt: What is on my Weeek board right now, and which tasks are assigned to me?
